title: Scout / research submarine (visual asset)
generator: Procedural geometry written in Python (Assets/ModelFactory/Tools/dlmesh.py + source/generate_dl001.py) run in a Claude session. Not AI text-to-3D, not hand-sculpted in Blender.
reference: Art/VisualReference/02_Submarine_Design.png (Scout length 8 m, width ~4.2 m, height 3.1 m)
units: metres in file (1 unit = 1 m in the design sheet); Roblox stud mapping to be set at import
axes: Y up, nose/front toward -Z, +X right (not verified against Roblox import)
pivot: Model origin (0,0,0) is the hull centreline at mid-length, roughly the vehicle root; not matched to the existing Studio submarine root (unknown).
license: Original procedural work created for the Deep Lantern project; no third-party assets used.
preview: preview.png is a software (numpy) render of the exported geometry; flat shading, not an engine render.
roblox_import: NOT TESTED. Suggested: import .glb/.obj via Studio 3D Importer, one MeshPart per material, set Anchored/CanCollide/CollisionFidelity in Studio; collision should use a simplified hull.
not_verified: fit against the existing live submarine/controller contracts
